body:
Step B3 of the multi-account design (, section 1 "Local area" and section 4).

* Account row with `kind = local`, no server, never synced, one per phone. Created from the start
  screen ("Use without an account") or from Accounts ("Add local area"). On creation a one-time
  note: lists here stay on this phone only, are not backed up and cannot be shared; sign in to a
  server any time to add shared lists.
* Only shopping lists and checklists: the New-list dialog hides the ledger kind under the local
  area, and the kind switch on List properties cannot pick ledger there. Members are shown as
  "You" only; roster, invites, close votes and the collaborator notification are hidden for local
  lists.
* Overview section "On this phone", last; phone glyph as card indicator. With only the local
  area present the overview is the plain single-account screen.
* Removing the local area is allowed only when it holds no lists (the row action is disabled
  with the reason); its lists are deleted one by one as today.
* Item and list `updated_by` stay the device id; field clocks work as today so a later copy
  (B4) into a server account carries sane values.
* Strings in nine locales; no web change (parity exception, recorded in B2).
* Tests: local account excluded from `SyncEngine`, kind restriction in the dialog and in
  `ListsRepo.setKind`, remove-only-when-empty, start screen creates the row and shows the note
  once.
title: Android: local-only area for shopping lists and checklists (B3)
